Scene 1: 生日未開始，先登入 (8 seconds; 00:00–00:08)
First-frame reference: K00.png
Last-frame reference: K01.png
[Scene & Action]
Live-action cinematic realism, 16:9. This is ONE continuous Hong Kong family birthday celebration, not a new episode or a new scene in another room. Start in the EXACT incoming first-frame pose and continue the same action without resetting. End in the supplied last-frame pose and hold it briefly. Fixed tripod camera, same lens and crop throughout; no cuts inside the clip, no zoom, no reframing, no transition, no dissolve, no montage, no stretching. Keep the same four Hong Kong Chinese actors: father (S1), salt-and-pepper hair, rectangular glasses and navy polo, seated LEFT; mother (S2), black bob and coral blouse, seated CENTER; adult son (S3), black hair and olive T-shirt, seated RIGHT on sofa; daughter (S4), ponytail, round glasses, mustard T-shirt and denim overalls, on the SAME stool beside the RIGHT cabinet. No seat swapping or teleportation. Teal curtains remain CLOSED throughout. Cake stays at the same spot on the coffee table with the SAME TWO LIT candles throughout; nobody blows them out, cuts or eats the cake yet. Keep the plant, tissue box, cabinet, monitor, ONE black speaker and ONE white indoor camera in fixed positions. All phones have physically normal front and rear surfaces; rear cameras never share a face with a display. The only computer is a low rounded-square silver mini PC with a smooth silver top, black lower seam and two stacked blue USB ports, situated inside the cabinet slot under the display. Exactly two arms and two hands per person. No duplicate objects. No subtitles, captions, lyrics, title cards, readable notification text, logos or floating graphics.

Warm room lights ON. The mother gestures gently toward her birthday cake and makes a practical request: dim the lights and play music so they can cut the cake. The father tries to open his light-control app, realizes he must sign in, then lifts the CLOSED brown password notebook from its existing table position and opens it on his lap while keeping his black phone in the other hand. His pleased expression becomes puzzled. The son checks a separate app on his own phone. The daughter keeps her pale phone ready to photograph the birthday. No new products or unrelated business. Timeline: 0.5-3.3s mother speaks; 3.8-5.8s father answers; the remaining time is silent reaction and notebook movement. End with the notebook open on father's lap.

In the last 5 seconds, show text overlay with light bluish transparent background and disappears only after 5 seconds:
各有各 app，雲端綁定，互不兼容

incompatible with each other
